title: documentation: airbnb example is not displaying well the slider
body:
I am not used to scss etc and wondering if we are importing all the required styles. If I add the instantsearch.css from jsdelivr it works better.

@redox any hints?

comments.body: The examples were created before the creation of the `instantsearch.css` file -> we need to update them to load it first (easier to understand than rebuilding everything from scratch I would say).
